title: Accounts Assistant
description:
Are you looking to join a friendly, supportive accountancy team where you can continue developing your skills, build strong client relationships and feel genuinely part of the team?

NXTGEN is pleased to be working with a well established accountancy practice that puts its people, teamwork and client relationships at the heart of what it does. This is a fantastic opportunity for an Accounts Assistant to join a collaborative team where you will be supported in your development, encouraged to take on new challenges and given the opportunity to progress your career.

Why join?
- A genuinely supportive team:Work alongside approachable colleagues who are happy to share their knowledge, offer guidance and help each other succeed.
- A positive working culture: Join a team where collaboration is valued, people work together to get the job done and you will never feel like just another number.
- Career development: Benefit from ongoing guidance and mentoring from experienced senior team members, helping you develop both your technical and client management skills.
- Study support: Continue working towards your professional qualifications with support to help you achieve your long term career goals.
- Varied client work: Gain exposure to a diverse portfolio of clients, allowing you to broaden your experience and develop your knowledge across different areas of accountancy.

Responsibilities will include:
- Preparing year end statutory accounts and corporation tax returns for a varied portfolio of clients.
- Completing bookkeeping, bank reconciliations and VAT returns.
- Preparing monthly and quarterly management accounts.
- Building and maintaining strong relationships with clients, providing support and guidance on their accounting needs.
- Using digital accounting software, including Xero and Dext, to support efficient ways of working.
- Working closely with colleagues across the team, sharing knowledge and supporting more junior members where appropriate.
- Managing your workload effectively to ensure deadlines are met and clients receive a consistently high standard of service.

The ideal Accounts Assistant will have:
- AAT qualification or equivalent.
- Previous experience working within an accountancy practice in a similar role.
- Good communication skills and the confidence to build positive relationships with clients and colleagues.
- A proactive approach, with the ability to manage your own workload while contributing to a wider team.
- A genuine interest in developing your technical knowledge and progressing within practice.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone who wants more than just their next role. If you are looking for a welcoming team, supportive management and the chance to develop your career within a people focused accountancy practice, we would love to hear from you.

Salary Offered D.O.E

title: Accounts Assistant
description:

title: Credit Controller
description:
The One Group are exclusively partnering with an established business based in Ely, who are looking to recruit for an experienced Credit Controller to join their team on a full time, permanent basis.

Schedule: Monday - Friday 08:30am - 5:00pm (37.5 hours per week)

This role would require you to work on-site everyday.

Responsibilities:
- Issue accurate and timely invoices to customers.
- Analyse financial data, credit reports, and payment histories to make informed credit decisions.
- Contact customers to follow up on outstanding balances and resolve payment discrepancies.
- Build and maintain positive relationships with customers while ensuring the prompt resolution of payment issues.
- Provide timely updates on credit-related issues to management.
- Evaluate the creditworthiness of new and existing customers.
- Prepare and present regular reports on the status of customer accounts, collections, and credit risk.

Requirements:
- Minimum of 2 years experience in a credit control focussed role
- Ability to work on-site Monday - Friday
- Good excel skills

Benefits:
- £30,000-£33,000 per annum, depending on experience
- 25 days holiday + bank holidays, rising with service
- 2 volunteering days per year
- Life Insurance (4x salary)
- Company social events
- Career development opportunities

If you are interested in this role, would like more information and your CV sent across to our client for consideration, please apply now and speak with Katherine Pearl at The One Group.

title: Part-time Finance Assistant - Remote
description:
Location: Remote with occasional office attendance as required
Hours: 25-30 hours per week,
Salary: £15.00-£16.00 per hour, depending on experience

The Opportunity

An established and growing organisation is seeking an experienced Finance Assistant to join its finance team on a temporary basis. This is an excellent opportunity for a finance professional who enjoys working in a fast-paced environment and is confident supporting a wide range of finance and accounting activities.

Working closely with internal stakeholders and the wider finance team, you will play a key role in maintaining accurate financial records, supporting reporting processes, and ensuring the smooth day-to-day running of finance operations.

Key Responsibilities
- Accurately process financial transactions and maintain organised financial records.
- Reconcile bank and card statements.
- Manage employee expense claims and ensure timely processing and reconciliation.
- Raise customer invoices and support accounts receivable activities.
- Monitor payments, assist with credit control, and resolve customer queries.
- Support month-end and year-end processes, including reconciliations and reporting.
- Assist with financial analysis and performance monitoring.

- Strong attention to detail and a high level of accuracy.
- The ability to analyse financial information and identify discrepancies.

- Strong organisational skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities effectively.
- A collaborative and proactive approach to work.

What's on Offer?
- Flexible remote working arrangement.
- Supportive and collaborative working environment.
- Opportunity to work across a broad finance remit.
- Competitive hourly rate based on experience.
- A chance to make an immediate impact within a well-established organisation.

title: Sales Ledger Assistant
description:

This is a fantastic opportunity to join a well-established and growing organisation that can offer long-term development and valuable experience within a finance environment. For more information, apply now or contact Jamie at Pure for an initial discussion.

title: Temporary Accounts Assistant
description:
We are supporting the search for a Temporary Accounts Assistant to join an established Finance team, based in Central Cambridge. This is an immediate requirement expected to last until the end of the year.

Key Responsibilities:
- Process supplier invoices, credit card transactions, internal expenses and recharged expenses accurately and efficiently.
- Maintain bookkeeping records across multiple group companies, ensuring financial information is recorded correctly.
- Investigate and resolve supplier queries while providing guidance to colleagues on expense-related matters.
- Identify opportunities to improve financial and administrative processes, systems and procedures.
- Support other areas of the Finance function, including sales ledger and reporting, as required.

The Ideal Candidate:
- Previous experience in a finance or finance-related role, including hands-on purchase ledger experience.
- Strong numerical skills, with excellent attention to detail and a commitment to maintaining accurate records.
- Confident communication skills and the ability to build effective working relationships with suppliers and internal stakeholders.
- Excellent organisational skills, with the ability to prioritise workloads, manage competing deadlines and work independently.

Please apply via the advert or contact John at Eclectic Recruitment for more information.
